     1	# Kubernetes Lando
     2	This module provides support for running Bespin jobs via a k8s cluster. This consists of two services. 
     3	- `k8s.lando` which listens for messages and runs k8s jobs while updating bespin-api
     4	- `k8s.watcher` which watches the k8s job listing and updates lando when jobs have completed, and logs failed jobs
     5	
     6	This requires bespin-api, postgres, and rabbitmq services to be running as outlined in [External services](#external-services) below.
     7	
     8	### External Cloud Support
     9	This module is designed to allow running workflows on an external kubernetes cloud without permissions to connect directly to the bespin cluster(rabbitmq and bespin-api). This allows the main application (bespin-api, rabbit, etc) to run on a private network while we can utilize an external k8s cluster for computation purposes. Part of the responsibility of `k8s.watcher` is to poll the external k8s cloud for finished jobs and add messages to the rabbitmq queue for lando to continue running the workflow.
    10	For the local openstack cloud the lando worker directly posts these messages to the rabbitmq queue for lando so there is no need for this watcher.
    11	
    12	### Job Monitoring
    13	The `k8s.watcher` is also necessary to monitor jobs due to the way kubernetes jobs are created/retried in the background. The k8s api returns immediately even if the job may fail to run for some reason. So a k8s job may fail without running any code and cannot report back to `k8s.lando` that the job has failed.
